## Summary

Describe the user-facing and technical changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=critical`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Review

- [ ] Mobile, tablet, desktop, ultrawide, and television-scale layouts reviewed
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and reduced-motion behaviour reviewed
- [ ] Metadata, links, project details, and contact information verified
- [ ] No credentials, generated files, reports, backups, or obsolete modules added
